name: Umi Swim School
description: Umi Swim School is a calm WordPress theme for swimming schools: a pool-edge photograph in a water-shaped blob overlapped by a translucent water blob, a horizontal day-schedule strip of oval-photo cards, a huge vertical section title with pill tabs, and white arc-top panels on a pale water-blue ground. Figtree and Inter Tight, with Noto Sans for Chinese and Japanese. Sample content in English. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; scroll effects respect reduced motion.
